title: Was, were, and once upon a time
summary: Put **to be** in the past with `-(y)DI` (*evdeydim*, *vardı*, *değildim*), tell what you saw from what you heard with `-(y)mIş` (*hastaymış*), and meet `-mIş` on verbs, the voice of news, discoveries and folk tales.
canDo: Say where you were and what the weather was like
Say what there was, what you had and what wasn't so
Pass on news you heard, and react to something you've just found out
Follow the opening of a folk tale
